en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town with fields in the foreground, rows of houses and industrial buildings in the middle distance, and a wooded hill crowned by a large castle‑like complex and a church tower in the background. The style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard. Red printed German text appears at the top identifying the place and the viewpoint.
